free_tier.stated: the Free DNS plan: unlimited records, 5 subdomain levels, 2 URL forwards, round-robin DNS of up to 10 records per host, API supported, minimum TTL 600 s; it is activated by default once a domain is added

per_object_cap.stated: no record cap on the Free plan (records unlimited); 5 subdomain levels, 2 URL forwards and up to 10 round-robin records per host

retention.stated: unverified: the plan, overview and API pages read state no inactivity, renewal or confirmation rule for a Free zone

egress.terms: no DNS query cap published on the pages read

interface_detail: a dynamic-DNS update call on the international API, POST https://api.dnspod.com/Record.Ddns with a login_token and the parameters domain_id, record_id, record_line and sub_domain; the pages read give no rate limit for it
tooling: curl or any HTTP client against the DNSPod API, and the DNSPod console; an update must name the domain_id and the record_id
chaining: a free zone for a domain the user already owns, with A, CNAME and subdomain records pointed at any address; it can hold a dynamic record but the 600 s minimum TTL slows how quickly an address change reaches resolvers

limits.value: 5 subdomain levels, 2 URL forwards, up to 10 round-robin records per host, minimum TTL 600 s on the Free plan

binding_note: the 600 s TTL floor decides for a dynamic record; the identity gate is a phone number with an SMS code

identity_cost.detail: the international site uses a Tencent Cloud account: an e-mail address with a code sent to it, then a mobile number of the registration location with an SMS code, at most 5 accounts per number; the +86 area code is not supported on the international site; no card is asked on the pages read (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/378/17985, https://docs.dnspod.com/account/accountupgrade/)

reliability_note: unverified: the pages read state no inactivity rule and no SLA for the Free plan
confidence_note: the plan overview, the dynamic-DNS API page, the Tencent Cloud sign-up page and the account-upgrade page were read and quoted; no sign-up form was submitted and the update call was not probed because it needs a token
